kind: route-scoped runtime binding; supplements P0 prototype-stage inventory

bindings.behavior: controlled exact RFC3339 window tuple; no manual date inputs; raw fractional precision retained

bindings.storage: immutable investigation.observation_queries.result plus current native session/grants/source checks; no export store or source query
bindings.projection: CSV of click-time visible sanitized rows; explicit total/returned/exported counts and fixed identity/window/digest
bindings.failure: 403/410/read failure prevents Blob creation; resource generation change drops late download; no cached success fallback
